title: Encoding a cube function as a Boolean proof
statement: For each natural number $n$ and each function from length-$n$ vectors over the two-element field to signs, define a Boolean function on the integers from $0$ to $2^n-1$ by converting each index back to a cube vector, evaluating the given function, and converting its sign value to a Boolean value.
